content.rationale: S5-marker-schema fixes the file's contents — markers and pos, closed — and T-state the two variables with empty/zero init; G-marker and S5-ids-only fix that a marker is one operation's own record — its kind, the change it targeted, its kept entry ids and the reverts recorded against it — and nothing else; D8b fixes where those entries come from — the entries within an operation's run window, attributed to the invoking workspace; M-layout places the module flat at src/markers.rs. This is the state behind markers.json: the marker list and the position, with the JSON mapping that makes the types the file's contents — closed objects and hex-string ids. The linear history (kpptprql) fixes the position: markers before it are applied, markers from it onward are the redo tail. Reading and writing the file is M-markers-persist's; the cursor guards are M-markers-guards'. I1-serde (`orrvsxqq`) fixes the JSON layer the module is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive. `target` is the change the operation acted on and is never empty — the schema refuses an empty one (zwurlynr).
